summary.intent: Review and improve code quality of a batch file upload feature (Phase 37), then assess and improve test coverage and build compatibility for the new encrypt worker.
summary.outcome: Fixed 3 code quality issues (type deduplication, removed task-reference comments, clarified worker comment), created PR #416, fixed a tsconfig gap for the encrypt worker, and added SDK integration tests and an SDK E2E batch upload test suite.

repo: EncryptionWorkerService had an inline encryption result type defined 4 times; the canonical type is ExternalEncryptFn from @cipherbox/sdk-core
apps/web/CLAUDE.md contains guidance against using Blob .buffer — existing upload.service.ts violates this and was pre-existing before Phase 37
The decrypt service worker has its own tsconfig.sw.json but the new encrypt worker was not included, meaning CI tsc would silently miss type errors in the worker
Vite handles new Worker(new URL(..., import.meta.url)) natively and @cipherbox/crypto uses only Web Crypto API, so no special build config is needed for dev/CI/prod
uploadFiles() (batch) had zero integration tests; only uploadFile() (singular) was covered in both integration.test.ts and sdk-e2e file-operations suite
All existing web E2E upload tests use serial single-file uploads via setInputFiles() — no batch upload E2E coverage existed

code.finding: Encrypt worker added to this tsconfig so tsc in CI will type-check it alongside the existing decrypt service worker
Batch upload integration test added after existing single-file tests
New file created for SDK E2E batch upload tests

workflow: Stale worktrees (cipher-box-worktree-parallel on docs/worktree-e2e-env-learnings) should be pruned after PR creation
Parallel subagents were used to simultaneously investigate SDK integration tests, web E2E coverage, and worker build compatibility

friction: The encrypt worker tsconfig gap was only discovered post-PR during the test coverage review, not during initial implementation — it should have been caught at PR authoring time
open_items: Upfront file buffer allocation (all files loaded as Uint8Array before upload): fixing requires changing SDK contract to accept File objects instead of Uint8Array; bounded by MAX_FILE_SIZE (100MB) but worth revisiting if batch sizes grow
Blob .buffer usage in upload.service.ts violates apps/web/CLAUDE.md guidance — pre-existing issue, should be fixed in a separate PR
Web E2E tests not updated: no coverage for multi-file batch upload, progress bars during concurrent uploads, partial failure, or cancellation flows
